title: Anima-nyet
description: It’s time for Anima-nyet! Comply or face max punishment! Join siblings Yakkov, Wakkov and Dotski as they sing about glorious Russia.
quote: Nyet, nyet, nyet! You shame our leader by underestimating reach of mighty Russian Federation!

alt4: human Yakkov, Wakkov and Dotski praying in front of a Putin painting
